name: Overspeeding
epl: @Name('Overspeeding') select e as event from Event as e where e.status='reconstructed' and e.streamId='speed-1' and e.value > 25

name: EngineOverheat
epl: @Name('EngineOverheat') select e as event from Event as e where e.status='reconstructed' and e.streamId='engine-temp-1' and e.value > 28

name: LowFuel
epl: @Name('LowFuel') select e as event from Event as e where e.status='reconstructed' and e.streamId='fuel-1' and e.value < 15.5

name: HighSpeedOverheat
epl: @Name('HighSpeedOverheat') select a as speedEvent, b as tempEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value > 20) -> b=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='engine-temp-1', value > 27)]

name: CriticalCondition
epl: @Name('CriticalCondition') select s as speedEvent, t as tempEvent, f as fuelEvent from pattern [every s=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value > 20) -> t=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='engine-temp-1', value > 27) -> f=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='fuel-1', value < 15.5)]

name: NormalCruise
epl: @Name('NormalCruise') select e as event from Event as e where e.status='reconstructed' and e.streamId='speed-1' and e.value between 15 and 25

name: GradualFuelDrop
epl: @Name('GradualFuelDrop') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='fuel-1') -> b=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='fuel-1', value < a.value)]

name: WarmEngine
epl: @Name('WarmEngine') select e as event from Event as e where e.status='reconstructed' and e.streamId='engine-temp-1' and e.value between 24 and 28

name: StopAndGo
epl: @Name('StopAndGo') select a as stop, b as go from pattern [every a=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value < 16) -> b=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value > 20)]

name: SpeedOscillation
epl: @Name('SpeedOscillation') select a as accel, b as brake from pattern [every a=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value > 22) -> b=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='speed-1', value < 18)]

name: OverheatCooldown
epl: @Name('OverheatCooldown') select hot as overheat, cool as cooldown from pattern [every hot=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='engine-temp-1', value > 28) -> cool=Event(status='reconstructed', streamId='engine-temp-1', value < 25)]
